## Review gate

A low finding is posted as a PR comment and held back from the
remediation round; it never blocks the merge decision on its own.

"""Post low-severity review findings as one PR comment."""

from __future__ import annotations


def low_findings_comment(findings: list[str]) -> str:
    """The one comment body that carries every held-back low finding."""
    lines = [f"- {f}" for f in findings]
    return "Held back from remediation (low):\n" + "\n".join(lines) + "\n"

"""The review gate: which findings a remediation round must address."""

from __future__ import annotations

HOLD_BACK = frozenset({"low"})


def must_remediate(severity: str) -> bool:
    """A low finding is commented on and held back, never remediated."""
    return severity not in HOLD_BACK

from kew.review_comments import low_findings_comment
from kew.review_gate import must_remediate


def test_a_low_finding_is_held_back() -> None:
    assert must_remediate("low") is False
    assert must_remediate("high") is True


def test_held_back_lows_are_one_comment() -> None:
    body = low_findings_comment(["naming", "docstring"])
    assert body.count("- ") == 2
